title: Itzhak Bentov's theories shaped CIA Gateway Process and Stargate

tellings.quote: His theories helped shape the foundation of the CIA's gateway process, [music] a protocol developed by consciousness researcher Robert Monroe in Virginia

plain: Michels says the ideas of Itzhak Bentov, an inventor who wrote the book Stalking the Wild Pendulum about consciousness, helped lay the groundwork for the CIA's Gateway Process. That was a method for reaching altered states of mind, developed in Virginia by the consciousness researcher Robert Monroe, and Michels also links Bentov to Stargate, the government's program that trained psychics to spy at a distance. Michels tells this himself in an episode about missing scientists, without naming a source, and if true it means a fringe theory of consciousness shaped real intelligence programs in the 1970s.
